_about: Cloud 2026-11-03, Complete Business English chapter 4 (bus-m4). English lines with no natural-voice clip in app/audio/en/manifest.json (checked with the app's ttsKey). Until clips exist the app plays them with the device voice; nothing fake was added. Priority: Learn phrases and speaking models (Play button) first, then vocab.
voice: default course narrator (as for the other courses' Learn phrases)
